rows.en:
(The way he was dragging it out,
I thought something was up...)

(Michel-kun sure gets a kick out of
teasing people...)

(Sigh~ Oh well.
I'll just enjoy having tea with Michel-kun.)

Wait, Michel?
What are you doing in a place like this?

Class was kinda, you know...
So I've been napping in here.
rows.notes: x2, Michel, both genders. 'chotto are' = vague 'not my thing'.

rows.en:
(He skips class and still ranks No. 1
in our year... Something about that
just doesn't sit right...)

No, it's nothing.
But how can you sleep in a room
this cluttered?

As long as nobody comes in,
this room's nice and quiet.
It's actually a pretty good spot to sleep.
Huh~ I never knew that.

You gotta try everything once.
Give it a shot yourself.

Relax, I won't try anything
while you're asleep.
rows.notes: x2, Michel, both genders. nekomi wo osou = jump someone in their sleep; teasing kept.

rows.en: O-Of course you won't!
Anyway, just try lying down.

(Easy for him to say, but I really
don't think I'll be able to sleep...)
Hey... Hey... Wake up, \p.
Mm, mmm......

Afternoon classes are over. School's out.
Or do you wanna keep sleeping?
What?! I was asleep this whole time!?

Oh, you were sleeping like a baby,
all right.

No way...
I never meant to fall asleep......

Hey, don't worry about it.
I got to see your adorable
sleeping face, after all.

Haha.
C'mon, school's over,
so let's head home.
(Ugh... I never meant to skip class...)

(And on top of that, Michel saw
my sleeping face... Ugh~......)

Wait, Michel-kun?
What are you doing in a place like this?

(He skips class and still ranks No. 1
in our year... Something about that
just doesn't sit right...)

No, it's nothing.
But how can you sleep in a room
this cluttered?
Huh~ I never knew that.
O-Of course you won't!
What?! I was asleep this whole time!?
M-Michel-kun!!

(And on top of that, Michel-kun saw
my sleeping face... Ugh~......)

(I left something in the storeroom again...
Hm? I hear something in there.
Could it be...?)

(Just as I thought, Michel's sleeping
in here...)

(I know! Last time he teased me about
seeing my sleeping face, so this time
I'll get a look at his!)

(Now that that's settled,
I'll get a little closer...)

...Leaning your face in that close...
What were you planning to do to me,
\p?
Why'd you have to wake up right now!?
Who knows...

Ah! You were awake the whole time,
weren't you!

I'm not telling anyone who tries
to sneak a peek at people's sleeping faces.

C'mon, if we don't hurry,
we'll be late for the next class.

(I tried to tease Michel, and he ended up
teasing me instead... Sigh...
I'm no match for Michel after all.)

(I left something in the storeroom again...
Hm? I hear something in there.
Could it be...?)

(Just as I thought, Michel-kun's sleeping
in here...)

(I know! Last time he teased me about
seeing my sleeping face, so this time
I'll get a look at his!)
Why'd you have to wake up right now!?

Ah! You were awake the whole time,
weren't you!

(I tried to tease Michel-kun, and he ended
up teasing me instead... Sigh...
I'm no match for Michel-kun after all.)

(Today I'm going shopping with Michel
in the Shibuya Area!)
(Huh? Michel's already here.)
Heeey, Michel! Sorry to keep you waiting.

Yo, \p.
It's still before the time we set, so no problem.
I just got here early, that's all.

Come to think of it, you're never late
for anything, are you, Michel?
Nobody likes a guy who can't be on time.
I see. That's Michel for you.

Make sure you're not late
when you go on a date, either.
Yes, sir. I'll take that to heart.
rows.notes: x2, both genders. Playfully formal reply to Michel.

rows.en: Alright, let's hurry up and go shopping.
rows.notes: x4: Michel here (both genders); also tagged PLAYER/none in the second frd_mcl_003 scene (the 199 call), where it seems to be a stray script line. Translated for Michel.

rows.en: Yeah, let's do that.
rows.notes: x22, the player, many scenes (frd_mcl, frd_pnn, nml_mcl, Christmas); generic agreement, as c07349.

rows.en:
(We hit all kinds of shops.
I'm pretty worn out.)
Wanna stop somewhere for tea, Michel?
Hey, Michel... Are you listening?
Heeey, Michel-kuuun~
rows.notes: x2, both genders. The male player uses -kun here as a teasing call.

rows.en:
(Hmm~ What's up with Michel?
Looks like he's staring hard at something...)
(Could it be......)
Sorry, \p.
Something just came up...

I don't even have to guess.
That 'something' is...

See ya. I'll definitely make it up to you
next time.
Ah! Michel!
Ahh~ Miss Sheryl?
rows.notes: x2, Michel, both genders. He calls out to a young woman as if mistaking her for Sheryl (pick-up line).

rows.en:
Oh, pardon me. You looked so captivating
from behind that I...

(That Michel... He ditched me
to go hit on girls...)

(Sigh, Michel's such a handful...
Oh well, I'll grab some tea by myself
and head home.)

(Today I'm going shopping with Michel-kun
in the Shibuya Area!)
(Huh? Michel-kun's already here.)

uncertain: c09897 also appears as a PLAYER/none line in the 199 phone-call scene of frd_mcl_003 (male and female), where it makes no sense; looks like a stray script line. Translated as Michel's line.
c09910: Michel greets a stranger as 'Miss Sheryl', taken as a pick-up line (or a genuine mistake) before c09911.
